newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian silver closes higher, gold steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian silver closes higher, gold steady.

text.p: Silver prices opened firm on Monday on thin supply and a shortage of ready stock and closed higher, aided by fresh industrial buying, dealers said.
"Sentiment at close remained firm but some traders were expecting prices to move higher, triggering profit-taking," said a dealer. Silver was up 15 rupees per kg on Saturday and 20 rupees last week.
Gold opened lower on light profit-taking and sluggish demand and closed steady in dull trade.
Gold biscuits (116.50 grammes each) settled 50 rupees lower at 59,300 rupees per piece. They gained 150 rupees on Saturday.
